audience: sales and service teams that keep customer accounts, cases and invoices in BlueCamroo

useCases.title: Look up an organization and its details
useCases.text: Search organizations by a name or another property, then open one to read its addresses and roles.

useCases.title: Review a customer case or opportunity
useCases.text: Open a case, a sales opportunity or a task by id to read its details before you reply or act.

useCases.title: Check a project invoice or sales quote
useCases.text: Open a project invoice or a sales quote by id to read its details before you answer a customer.

useCases.title: Review logged time and calendar events
useCases.text: Read a logged time entry or a calendar event by id, and a project by id, to review the work done.

useCases.title: Log a follow-up task for a contact
useCases.text: Read a person by id, then create a task with a subject and a priority, linked to that person.

useCases.title: Add a person or change their details
useCases.text: Create a new person, or change only the fields you give on an existing one. Fields you leave out stay the same.
